description: Query Reflex activation records with KQL. The response contains one positional table per query statement.
notes: Rows are arrays whose values align positionally with columns. Current columnType values are Bool, DateTime, Decimal, Dynamic, Guid, Int, Long, Real, String, and TimeSpan; additional values may appear over time. Standard KQL data queries, explicit union across activation tables, '.show tables', and '.show table <name> cslschema' are supported. 'union *' and other management commands are rejected. Query text is limited to 1,048,576 characters and may time out after about 30 seconds.
